 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ja Morant's first meeting with his former team as a Portland Trail Blazer came to an early end, after the guard exited the game with a left hamstring injury. Morant was officially ruled out by the team during the fourth quarter of Thursday's game against the Memphis Grizzlies.
 Morant was set up for an early meeting with his old team, just four months after the blockbuster trade that sent Morant to Portland . But the Grizzlies got the last laugh in the end, picking up a 124-103 win in Portland's Moda Center.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Prior to leaving with the injury, Morant struggled with shooting but dropped some big highlights in the contest. In one moment late in the second quarter, the guard dropped a floating jumper past Grizzlies guard Cedric Coward; Morant then seemingly mouthed "he food" at the crowd while pointing towards Coward.
 Morant finished with 14 points, two rebounds and three assists in 23 minutes of play.
 The game was close at first, with the two teams tied up at halftime, but Memphis started to pull away in the second half to get the win. Cameron Boozer, the No. 3 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft , earned his first triple-double (18 points, 12 rebounds, 12 assists) in the victory, which moves the Grizzlies to 5-0 on the season.
 This story will be updated.
